fib: ______ is a scatter of related values, such as the assortment of weights in a group of cattle.
distribution
A distribution is a scatter of related values, such as the assortment of weights in a group of cattle.
______ is used when the samples are not drawn from normal distribution.
Wilcoxon signed rank test
Wilcoxon signed rank test is used when the samples are not drawn from normal distribution.
______ is a descriptive property that describes/characterize a population such as descriptive property is referred to as a parameter (e.g., means).
Parameters
Parameters is a descriptive property that describes/characterize a population such as descriptive property is referred to as a parameter (e.g., means).
______ is one of the most known tools for qualitative data.
Simple Correspondence analysis
Simple Correspondence analysis is one of the most known tools for qualitative data.
______ is a field of investigation concerned with the structure and planning of experiments.
Experimental design
Experimental design is a field of investigation concerned with the structure and planning of experiments.
______ is an estimator of the population parameter from the sample. v.
statistic
A statistic is an estimator of the population parameter from the sample. v.
______ is a special case of a 3-way classification, with rows, column and treatments.
design
The design is a special case of a 3-way classification, with rows, column and treatments.
______ is defined as the entire collection of measurements about which the statistician wishes to draw conclusion.
Population/Universe
Population/Universe is defined as the entire collection of measurements about which the statistician wishes to draw conclusion.
______ is a subset of all the measurements in the population of interest.
Samples
Samples is a subset of all the measurements in the population of interest.
______ are called relative frequency histograms or percentage histograms and relative frequency polygons or percentage polygon respectively.
resulting graphs
The resulting graphs are called relative frequency histograms or percentage histograms and relative frequency polygons or percentage polygon respectively.
______ is the entire process of using an estimator to produce an estimate of a parameter.
Estimation
Estimation is the entire process of using an estimator to produce an estimate of a parameter.
______ is a graph in which classes are marked on the horizontal axis and the frequencies, relative frequencies, or percentages are marked on the vertical axis.
histogram
A histogram is a graph in which classes are marked on the horizontal axis and the frequencies, relative frequencies, or percentages are marked on the vertical axis.
______ can be defined as the chance of an event occurring.
Probability
Probability can be defined as the chance of an event occurring.
______ is a statistical tool used to detect differences between experimental group means.
Analysis of variance (ANOVA)
Analysis of variance
ANOVA
Analysis of variance (ANOVA) is a statistical tool used to detect differences between experimental group means.
______ can be defined as the sum of the observed values of a set divided by the number of observations in the set.
Mean
Mean can be defined as the sum of the observed values of a set divided by the number of observations in the set.
______ is a line graph of class frequency plotted against class mark.
frequency polygon
A frequency polygon is a line graph of class frequency plotted against class mark.
______ is used to verify if the prior classification is confirmed after using the explicative variables.
Discriminant analysis
Discriminant analysis is used to verify if the prior classification is confirmed after using the explicative variables.
______ is used to verify formulated tests and hypotheses.
Statistics
Statistics is used to verify formulated tests and hypotheses.
